## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you would like to see in BMQOS.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
Example: *It is cumbersome to manage multiple agent workforce instances when...*

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you would like to see implemented, including UI mockups, API design, or workflow changes where relevant.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you considered and why they were not ideal.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, links, or screenshots about the feature request here.
